questions.prompt: The hypocrite says one thing, but he thinks another.
questions.answer: Aliud simulātor loquitur, aliud sentit.

questions.prompt: Some resisted, while others fled headlong through the smoke.
questions.answer: Aliī restitērunt, aliī per fūmum praecipitēs fūgērunt.

questions.prompt: One general ruined the army, the other sold the camp.
questions.answer: Alter dux exercitum perdidit, alter castra vēndidit.

questions.prompt: Though besieged, the Gauls encouraged each other with words.
questions.answer: Quamquam obsessī, Gallī alius alium verbīs cohortātī sunt.

questions.prompt: In this temptation one man craves one thing, another another.
questions.answer: In hāc tentātiōne alius aliud cupit.

questions.prompt: One thing pleases some, another others, as the poet sings.
questions.answer: Aliud aliīs placet, ut poēta canit.

questions.prompt: Terrified by the fire, some flee in one direction, others in another.
questions.answer: Incendiō territī aliī aliō fugiunt.

questions.prompt: This leader surpasses all the others in wisdom.
questions.answer: Hic dux cēterīs sapientiā praestat.

questions.prompt: The one party retreated to the mountain, the other betook itself to the baggage.
questions.answer: Alterī sē in montem recēpērunt, alterī ad impedīmenta sē contulērunt.

questions.prompt: The suppliant asks one thing, but wishes another.
questions.answer: Aliud supplex rogat, sed aliud vult.

questions.prompt: The citizens, gathered together, snatched weapons from each other.
questions.answer: Cīvēs congregātī alius aliī arma ēripuērunt.

questions.prompt: One brother extinguished the fire, the other carried water.
questions.answer: Alter frāter ignem exstīnxit, alter aquam portāvit.

questions.prompt: Some gave thanks, others complained about the victor.
questions.answer: Aliī grātēs ēgērunt, aliī dē vīctōre questī sunt.

questions.prompt: The leader spared the rest of the captives.
questions.answer: Dux cēterīs captīvīs pepercit.

questions.prompt: The three others brought aid to the besieged town.
questions.answer: Reliquī trēs oppidō obsessō subsidium tulērunt.

questions.prompt: In war one man dreads one thing, another another.
questions.answer: In bellō alius aliud timet.

questions.prompt: One consul praised the soldiers, the other chastised them.
questions.answer: Alter cōnsul mīlitēs laudāvit, alter castīgāvit.

questions.prompt: Some worship the gods willingly, others by force.
questions.answer: Aliī deōs sponte colunt, aliī vī.

questions.prompt: The wise man says one thing, the fool another.
questions.answer: Aliud sapiēns dīcit, aliud stultus.

questions.prompt: One wall stood firm, the other collapsed in the fire.
questions.answer: Alter pariēs stetit, alter in igne cecidit.

questions.prompt: This one virtue is superior to all the others.
questions.answer: Haec ūna virtūs cēterīs praestat.

questions.prompt: Some praised the orator's speech, others jeered at it.
questions.answer: Aliī ōrātiōnem laudāvērunt, aliī dērīsērunt.

questions.prompt: One soldier hurled his spear, the other drew his sword.
questions.answer: Alter hastam iēcit, alter gladium strīnxit.

questions.prompt: The terrified citizens fled apart, some one way, others another.
questions.answer: Territī cīvēs aliī aliō diffūgērunt.

questions.prompt: Some messenger or other announced that the walls had fallen.
questions.answer: Nescio quis nūntiāvit mūrōs cecidisse.

questions.prompt: One officer procured the grain, the other armed the soldiers.
questions.answer: Alter frūmentum comparāvit, alter mīlitēs armāvit.

questions.prompt: In the assembly one man demands one thing, another another.
questions.answer: In contiōne alius aliud postulat.

questions.prompt: The four others swam across the swollen river by night.
questions.answer: Reliquī quattuor flūmen tumidum nocte trānāvērunt.

questions.prompt: This queen surpassed all the others in beauty and cunning.
questions.answer: Haec rēgīna cēterīs pulchritūdine et calliditāte praestitit.

questions.prompt: The victorious enemies plundered one another amid the ruins.
questions.answer: Victōrēs hostēs alius alium inter ruīnās spoliāvērunt.

questions.prompt: One thing pleases some judges, another pleases others.
questions.answer: Aliud aliīs iūdicibus placet.

questions.prompt: Somehow or other the letter reached the exiled king.
questions.answer: Nescio quō pactō epistula ad rēgem exsulantem pervēnit.

questions.prompt: The one party stormed the gates, the other set fire to the towers.
questions.answer: Alterī portās oppugnāvērunt, alterī turrēs incendērunt.

questions.prompt: Among the young men one loves one thing, another another.
questions.answer: Inter iuvenēs alius aliud amat.

questions.prompt: Some were carrying torches, others rolling stones down the slope.
questions.answer: Aliī facēs gerēbant, aliī saxa per clīvum volvēbant.

questions.prompt: One twin was braver, the other more prudent.
questions.answer: Alter geminus fortior, alter prūdentior erat.

questions.prompt: The tyrant sent some soldier or other to guard the captives.
questions.answer: Tyrannus nescio quem mīlitem ad captīvōs custōdiendōs mīsit.
